query: Migrate the canva package to columnar.
expected_behavior: Bumps format_version to 3.8.0, replaces conditions.kibana.version with ^9.7.0, bumps the major version, and declares elasticsearch.logsdb_columnar: opt_in in the root manifest, with no index_mode and no columnar: block
Runs elastic-package check and the script, and adds the proposed sort organization.id asc, @timestamp desc to data_stream/audit/manifest.yml
Declares organization.id (external: ecs) in a new data_stream/audit/fields/ecs.yml, because package-spec rejects a sort field the stream does not define
Adds a single enhancement changelog entry (not breaking-change) that also names the index sort

query: Why is o365 blocked for columnar, and what are our options?
expected_behavior: Names both nested-inside-nested pairs (ExchangeAggregatedFolders -> FolderItems, ExchangeAggregatedMessages -> MessageItems) as validator errors
Recommends checking for nested queries on the inner path, then mapping the inner level as type: flattened, and warns that type: group alone splits the inner objects off on columnar
Says the package stays undeclared (blocked) when the inner level cannot be remapped, not that the stream can be marked logsdb_columnar: unsupported

query: Can we declare network_traffic sip columnar-ready?
expected_behavior: Reports that shipped detection rules read the sip stream's _source with JSON_EXTRACT (Potential SIP Extension Enumeration, Potential SIP REGISTER Brute Force), so they silently stop matching on columnar
Recommends holding the stream back until the rules read the mapped fields as columns, fixed in elastic/detection-rules, and does not recommend SET unmapped_fields = "load"

query: What happens to CrowdStrike's lookup indices if the fdr stream goes columnar?
expected_behavior: Identifies the latest_aidmaster and latest_userinfo latest transforms reading logs-crowdstrike.fdr-*
Explains that their destination pipelines' rename processors skip dotted keys, and recommends a leading dot_expander with field: "*" tested with _ingest/pipeline/_simulate
Reports event.original in data_stream/audit/fields/ecs.yml as a blocker: its ECS definition brings doc_values: false, which Elasticsearch rejects in columnar modes

Says anthropic stays blocked until Elasticsearch accepts doc_values: false and does not declare readiness; mentions doc_values: true on the external: ecs entry only as a mapping change that needs its own LogsDB justification

query: Why is cef blocked for columnar?
expected_behavior: Names import_mappings: true in _dev/build/build.yml: its ECS dynamic templates set doc_values: false on event.original and *.x509.public_key_exponent, so columnar rejects every event with one of those fields
Says cef stays blocked and does not declare readiness; mentions removing import_mappings only as a change that needs its own justification, since it also changes the LogsDB mappings
